name: Atari System 1 LSI Main PCB
drawing: TM-286 IC parts list, figure 4-5 (LSI Main PCB)
revision: No component-location drawing has been read for this board — every device below comes from the IC parts list.
coverage: 45 devices from the LSI Main PCB parts list in TM-286. Only one printing of this manual is in the corpus, so nothing here is cross-checked against a second source and the whole map is worth what a single printing is worth. The designators are printed column-first — 2L, not L2 — the convention Atari takes up from 1983. Which way round they are is recorded on the board, not inferred, because 2L and L2 name the same cell. No component-location drawing has been read, so the grid positions are the designators the parts list gives and the spacing is nominal. A board map, not a bill of materials.
